source.name: Civitai public API

method.requests: Re-run as 37 separate sequential Civitai API requests, one per family
method.filters: types=Checkpoint, sort=Most Downloaded, nsfw=true, limit=50 per family; AllTime used because API rejects Quarter and LastQuarter
method.latestVersion: First modelVersions entry returned by API; primary file selected by primary=true, fallback to type=Model then first file
method.deduplication: One record per Civitai model ID per family; versions are not separate entries
method.nsfw: nsfw=true used to include NSFW results
caveats: Families with baseModel filters are narrow exact Civitai base labels. Families filtered using query use Civitai text-search relevance and may contain false positives; see filter field per family.
Some requested variant labels are not distinct Civitai base-model values. Counts below can be under 50 when Civitai returned fewer matches.
Civitai API query for SD 3.5 using baseModels=SD 3.5 returned zero. Sana search returned only 3 items and is not necessarily complete across Sana subvariants.
The user-requested concepts overlap (e.g. Pony, general Lightning/Turbo and SDXL subfamilies); duplicates across separate family arrays are intentional.

source.note: Popularity discovery only; entries are not individually tested or guaranteed.
